title: Pushout to an effacing sequence
statement: Let F be a cohomological delta-functor [def-weil-pbc-delta-functor] between abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], effaceable in degree n+1. Every short exact sequence S admits a morphism to the cokernel sequence of an effacing monomorphism w:S.X₁→Y, whose left component is the identity.

source.place: Lemma Tag 010T (lemma-efface-implies-universal), with its proof (induction on n through the cokernel description F^{n+1}(A)=Coker(F^n(B)->F^n(C)); the verification that t^{n+1} is a natural transformation is 'omitted' in Stacks and must be written out at the split)

proof.text:
Every short exact sequence maps to an effacing one fixing its left object.

Source: Stacks Project, Homology, Lemma 010T, compatibility verification;
the pushout argument is step 8 of the parent node. Push out S.f along an
effacing monomorphism u. The pushout inclusion of S.X₂ is monic, so its
composite w with S.f is monic. The pushout equation factors w through u,
hence F(w) = 0. Since S.g is a cokernel of S.f, the map from S.X₂ to the
cokernel of w descends through S.g. Together with the identity on S.X₁
and the pushout inclusion it gives the required morphism.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 010T, induction construction; the omitted independence, naturality and connecting-map compatibility verifications are supplied by J2 using the parent node direct-sum and pushout arguments.
